name: What would you do?
description: Superpowers, strokes of luck and life swaps.

hipoteticos-si-pudieras-elegir-un-poder.text: If you could pick one power:

hipoteticos-como-prefieres-el-dinero.text: How would you rather get the money?
options: 1 million right now, all at once
4,000 euros a month for the rest of your life
Barely scraping by, loving what you do

hipoteticos-que-vida-prefieres-sano-y-en.text: Which would you rather have? (healthy and fit the whole time)

hipoteticos-te-dan-un-mando-para-tu-vida.text: You get a remote control for your life. Which button?

hipoteticos-te-toca-la-eternidad-en-uno-.text: You have to spend eternity in one of these. Which do you pick?
options: A perfect but mind-numbingly boring heaven
A fun hell with constant pain

hipoteticos-te-reencarnas-en-lo-que-peor.text: You're reincarnated as the creature you hate most. Which would you rather be?
options: A mosquito that lives one day annoying people
Wipe out all your debts today

hipoteticos-si-tu-cuerpo-no-necesitara-u.text: If your body could stop needing one thing:

hipoteticos-quien-usaria-sus-superpodere.text: Who would use their superpowers for evil without a second thought?

hipoteticos-quien-se-gastaria-un-millon-.text: Who would blow a million euros in less than a month?

hipoteticos-quien-malgastaria-un-deseo-m.text: Who would waste a magic wish on something completely pointless?
